newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Far East Bank declares four peso cash div.
newsitem.headline: Far East Bank declares four peso cash div.

text.p: Far East Bank & Trust Co (FEBTC) said on Wednesday its board had approved a cash dividend of four pesos per share to stockholders of record as of September 30, 1996.
The bank said in a statement the new cash dividend will be subject to approval by the Central Bank.

In the event that the bank's application for a stock split is approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the cash dividend will be adjusted accordingly to 0.40 peso from four pesos, the statement said.
The bank's board had already declared two cash dividends of four pesos each for the past two quarters.
In 1995, it declared three cash dividends -- four pesos in March, three pesos in July and four pesos in September.
